ms.promise:
・Implementation of animated QR code reading and generating functionality, enabling the SeedSigner to receive data from and transmit data via animated QRs.
・Implement exporting the root public key as the first use case for data transmission.
ms.criteria:
・The application must be capable of reading animated QR codes to receive data and generate animated QR codes for transmitting data.
・The SeedSigner must successfully demonstrate exporting the root public key using the animated QR code protocol.
ms.report:
Here are my deliverables for this milestone. Animated QR code reading and generation, and extended public key export, have been implemented and tested on SeedSigner hardware. The following evidence is required for this milestone:
・Video, animated QR read/generate and extended public key export (this video shows both A functional demonstration of animated QR code reading and generation on SeedSigner hardware and the export of the root public key using animated QR codes): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZpPC96Qu9supfCnnIegJkzVgjcQQABB2/view 
・Source code: https://github.com/Biglup/cardano-seedsigner/commit/edb66f86108261e2deeba6e756877c2c0318c4ae

 (Commit [edb66f86108261e2deeba6e756877c2c0318c4ae])
In the video a sample application displays an animated QR requesting the public key. The SeedSigner reads the animated request, the user approves the export on-device, and the device transmits the extended public key back as an animated QR, which the application reads and uses to display the key and its derived addresses.

ms.promise:
・Functionality for receiving transactions to be signed via animated QR codes.
・Display of transaction details to the user for confirmation before signing.
・Implementation of signing the transaction and transmitting the witness data to the other device using animated QR codes.
ms.criteria:
・The application must be capable of reading animated QR codes to receive transaction data.
・Transaction details must be displayed to the user for review and confirmation before signing.
・The signed transaction (witness data) must be transmitted to the other device using animated QR codes.
ms.report:
The milestone delivers the full air-gapped transaction-signing loop on SeedSigner hardware: a transaction is received as an animated QR code, its details are displayed for review and confirmation, the transaction is signed on the air-gapped device, and the resulting witness data is transmitted back to the companion device as an animated QR code.
・This is a video demostrating transaction reception, review, signing, and transmission via animated QR codes on SeedSigner hardware. I am also attaching the CBOR of the transaction being signed and the resulting witness will be shared in .txt files.
・Video demostration: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IM3UDtREIyyY-moe5fnid-JVJriKxMZe/view?usp=sharing
・CBOR of the sign request: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kKv_q71oLDVh12i3p5TXlOypNXki6JqY/view?usp=sharing
・CBOR of the response with the witness: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oqAjalLK18HeJWtjamSQ0nKZdLDcrIc5/view?usp=sharing
・CBOR of the signed transaction: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1r5wKwC1pBqqcCuOJGd9Y65-kNYK2H4wH/view?usp=sharing
・Link to Cardano Scan with the transaction signed in the video demostration: https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/0f2d5422b3d8143f09e4029dc48ce52c0405cf5fab34cf134f5278a264ae613c
・Source code of the update on GitHub, documenting the implementation of transaction signing and the QR code transmission protocol: https://github.com/Biglup/cardano-seedsigner/commit/771ea2585a2f00e7eb61c4e3d7566e16a1092d93
・Commit Hash: 771ea2585a2f00e7eb61c4e3d7566e16a1092d93
